svg.aria-label: NitroStack AWS Supply Chain solution architecture
svg.text: End-to-end reference · human (PKCE) and operator (MCP) paths on one API surface
Local: AWS SSO or IAM role

g.text: Create order → catalog lookup → inventory reserve → persist order → return JSON
Cancel releases stock via inventory invoke
Secrets Manager: URLs, OAuth, table names
IAM per function · unified app secret version
Bounded contexts — inventory never on HTTP
Observability — X-Ray + correlation IDs in Lambdas
⇄ Animated trucks = request + response · Open in browser for full motion (GitHub README shows static SVG)
